text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Chasing after a budding racer was not my
brightest idea. I've
completely lost sight of her...
Her distressed expression still vivid in 
my mind, I continue my search.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her enthusiasm completely backfired
today. Between being late, tripping during
her run, and causing Opera O to have a
near-death
experience...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Worried, I search the academy grounds.
After what feels like half an
hour...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huff, puff, huff, puff!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I... I can do better... I will do better! For Opera O!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I have to run properly on the day of the
race... Th-then... maybe
someday I'll...
O-one more lap!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Raaaah!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto wipes the tears from her
puffy, reddened eyes and
makes a dash
for the riverside.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Thud!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Eeeaargh?!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: ...Only to fall into a ditch.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: That could've been bad... Thank you... Sniff...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Yes... I'm, um... kinda used to falling at this point... Sigh...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...Why am I... like this?

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Her clothes are completely covered in
mud, and it's already quite
late. Just as I'm
about to urge her to return home, she
raises her head.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I... have to try harder! Yeah!
Time for some
long-distance running!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Ah, I'm s-s-sorry! Is that a...
problem?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
N-no, not at all! I'd say I'm more, um...
stubborn than hardworking...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Whenever I think about quitting, I just
start remembering... and I start
feeling like
maybe... just maybe... even I can—

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Um...
It's not a very exciting story...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
It happened a long time ago, when I went
to see my first G1 race... 
The racers, the
crowd, the very race itself was just so...
magical.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
At first,
I thought of it all as a completely
different world... One where someone like
me could never exist... until I heard the
winner's speech.

text_block_list.name: G1 Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
I used to have no confidence in myself. I
truly believed I could do nothing right...
But as I started winning races, I began to
see myself in
a new light.

text_block_list.name: G1 Umamusume
text_block_list.text:
Now, after winning such an amazing race, I
can sincerely say that I
love myself!

text_block_list.name: Young Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Does... Does that mean that if I try hard
enough, I can change too?

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
After that, I got all excited and applied
for Tracen Academy... And
somehow I got
in. Ahaha...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Yeah... I-I know I'm a klutz,
and nothing I
do ever turns out right... But
I still have a
hard time telling when it's time to give
up...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
I keep hoping that if I keep trying,
someday I'll be like that winner back
then...
or maybe even a majestic racer like
Opera O...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
And before I knew it, it became even
harder to give up... So not only
am I a
klutz, I'm a stupid one at that...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Meisho Doto's already hard on herself by
default, but she's even worse today. It's
clear she sees herself in a negative
light,
but...

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
Today was an indisputable disaster, but
even then, she's out here
preparing for the
Tracen Meet. To me, that takes true grit.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
Huh? A g-good thing? S-s-sorry, I must've
misheard you...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I didn't mishear you?!

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
U-um... A-a-are you sure about that? I
mean... all I'm doing is just
trudging along,
not knowing when to give up...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: I-I'm not so sure about that...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: ...Ehehe, I'm glad you think so, though...

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text:
A-anyway, I, ummm... I think I'm going to
run a little more before
going back to the
dorm! H-have a good night!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text:
As Meisho Doto runs off into the distance,
I can feel a faint strength
coming from her
unlike anything I've ever felt before.

text_block_list.name: Meisho Doto
text_block_list.text: Huff... Huff... Here I go!
